test_title: PYST 167: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 09 Feb, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students Fernandes, Dsouza, Marc, Dmello, Anthony and Charlene are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Fernandes is sitting to the immediate right of Dsouza. Marc is sitting second to the left of Fernandes. Anthony is sitting second to the right of Dsouza. Dmello is sitting to the immediate left of Marc. Charlene is sitting to the immediate right of Anthony. Who is sitting between Fernandes and Charlene?
solution:
Given: Six students Fernandes, Dsouza, Marc, Dmello, Anthony and Charlene are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Fernandes is sitting to the immediate right of Dsouza.

2) Marc is sitting second to the left of Fernandes.

3) Anthony is sitting second to the right of Dsouza.

4) Dmello is sitting to the immediate left of Marc.

5) Charlene is sitting to the immediate right of Anthony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60330fa57d0a144f7424e56459d60de223de2dbaa3a0f7496c0dd4db1c0e268e.png] 

Here, 'Anthony' is sitting between Fernandes and Charlene.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
